title: Secret electrogravitic propulsion programs
plain: The US has secret programmes building craft that fly by electrogravitics, the idea that electric fields can be used to push against gravity. A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says this to Michels, naming the field in two words, "Electromagnetic. Electrogravitic," and tying it to the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who worked on the idea. If true, a form of flight with no rockets or wings would already exist in secret.
